clips.title: The story
paras: Delgren's crusade against the Tower of Althalaxx cultists reaches its sixth chapter. From Maestra's Post, he deciphers orcish writings recovered from the cult's emissaries and learns that Athrikus Narassin hid two trapped Highborne soulgems in satyr strongholds deep in Ashenvale. Champions head to Night Run and Satyrnaar to shatter the vessels, free the tormented spirits, and weaken Athrikus's power.

Delgren the Purifier puts his study of Orcish to use after Ilkrud Magthrull, an orcish courier, is cut down. His peers in the Holy Light often scoffed at learning an adversary's tongue, but Delgren's practical insight lets him decipher notes recovered from the cult's emissaries. They reveal that Athrikus Narassin hid two potent soulgems containing ancient Highborne essences far to the northeast, in the defiled groves of Night Run and Satyrnaar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my enemies.
From Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast Ashenvale.
Be careful out there, friend, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned adventurer such as yourself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I heard whisper once that the satyrs' history is somehow related to that of the night elves, but I have found my esteemed hosts reticent to speak of the matter.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perhaps the satyrs have been allowed to persist in the forest for too long. I will speak with Elissa about it when next I travel to Auberdine.
Nonetheless, with the soulgems destroyed, Athrikus' power will be greatly diminished. We must seize on this opportunity to eliminate him and his cult.
